keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Eichstätt row). The page: 'The total area was about 1100 km2, with a population of 58,000 (as of 1855)'; 'as of 1789, consisted of one main part to the east' and other fragments mostly within Brandenburg-Ansbach. A 19 km circle at Eichstätt (11.18E 48.89N, about 1,130 km2) matches the area, soft; the fragments are not drawn.

ledger.note: 1305: the prince-bishopric. Infobox 'Prince-Bishopric: 1305'; the diocese 'was established in 746' (the infobox gives 741). The page also names Hirschberg Castle as a secondary residence from 1305 and the lands inherited from the extinct Counts of Hirschberg (no year).

1802: secularised. Infobox 'Mediatised to Salzburg: 1802'; the bishopric 'was secularized and was in 1803' given in compensation 'to Archduke Ferdinand of Habsburg-Lorraine'; the page then has it go to Bavaria after the Treaty of Pressburg (Austerlitz, 1805).

certainty.note: The page gives the area (about 1,100 km2) and no boundary; the single circle stands for the main part and the fragments are not drawn.
